title: Massive GTA 6 leaks reveal access to a playable version of the game
summary: Multiple outlets confirm that a leaker has shared footage of a playable build of GTA 6, while Rockstar and Take-Two attempt to contain the spread.

title: FromSoftware reveals details of The Duskbloods, its Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, amid leaks and Miyazaki statements
summary: The new FromSoftware game shows leaked gameplay with PvP combat and confirms George R.R. Martin's collaboration, while Nintendo denies its release date.

title: Riot Games cancels development of 2XKO, its League of Legends fighting game, less than a year after launch
summary: The studio confirms that active development will end in December, marking the end of the project after a lukewarm reception.

title: Creators of Black Myth: Wukong show 15 minutes of gameplay of their next title, Black Myth: Zhong Kui
summary: The spiritual successor features brutal combat against grotesque bosses and parry mechanics, generating great anticipation in the community.

title: Physical game sales in the US drop to lowest level since 1995 in a disastrous July for the industry
summary: Spending on hardware and software plummets to pandemic levels, with Xbox especially affected and not even Call of Duty Black Ops 2 surpassing current figures.

title: Saudi Arabia's purchase of EA raises fears of layoffs and interference, casting doubt on Mass Effect's future
summary: Former executives and employees criticize the deal, warning that the company's culture lacks 'moral backbone' to resist Saudi influence.

title: 007 First Light surpasses four million sales and confirms Nintendo Switch 2 release
summary: IO Interactive celebrates the commercial milestone of the James Bond game, which will also be available on Nintendo's next console.

title: Nintendo raises Switch 2 price in UK and warns 70 million users won't escape the increase
summary: The company confirms the price hike for its new console in the British market, extending the measure globally.

title: Another Crab's Treasure arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 with enhanced edition and free update for owners
summary: The acclaimed crustacean soulslike launches on Nintendo's new console with technical improvements and no additional cost for those who already own it.

title: God of War series finds its new Kratos and fans celebrate the choice
summary: Amazon and Sony confirm the actor who will replace Christopher Judge in the TV adaptation, generating positive reactions.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners returns with second season scheduled for October 2025
summary: CD Projekt Red and Studio Trigger announce the anime's continuation with a brutal trailer confirming its Netflix premiere.

title: Geoff Keighley clarifies selection criteria for Gamescom Opening Night Live: 'Have something exciting to show'
summary: The event organizer explains that inclusion does not depend on payments, but on the relevance of announcements.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta eliminates 'Compiling shaders' wait on PC and opens registrations for two weekends
summary: Activision improves the technical experience in the pre-launch test, allowing players to register for early access.

title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles composer denounces AI-generated album on Spotify falsely using her name
summary: Kumi Tanioka denies her involvement in the album and warns about unauthorized use of her identity on streaming platforms.

title: New Silent Hill: Townfall trailer divides fans over its focus on firearms and a strange reference to Scotland
summary: The shown gameplay reintroduces gun combat, which some consider alien to the series' essence, while highlighting a curious electric payment mechanic.
